title: Agentic Operating Systems, Advanced RAG & Cognitive Architecture Blueprint
author: Shothik Core Architecture Lab

frameworks.heading: 1. Noetherian Momentum Invariant
frameworks.summary: Maximizes execution momentum by maximizing user intent comprehension and epistemic verification while driving UI and cognitive friction to near-zero.

chunks.content: Momentum Invariant is M = (Intent * Verification) / Friction. Intent measures how effortlessly the natural language goal is understood without mode toggles. Verification measures verifiable provenance and trust. Friction is every latency, modal popup, and setup toggle.

First paint must show only the calm heading 'What do you want to accomplish today?' and 3 outcome starter prompts (Research, Analysis, Create). Prohibits onboarding boxes, setup checklists, and launcher chip walls.

frameworks.heading: 2. 4-Way Fused Enterprise Cognitive RAG
frameworks.formula: S_fused = (w_dense * RRF_dense + w_sparse * RRF_sparse + w_graph * S_graph) * e^(-lambda * delta_t)
frameworks.summary: Replaces naive single-vector search with Magika pre-validation, parent-child chunking, dense + sparse hybrid RRF, cross-encoder reranking, and contradiction detection.

chunks.content: Child chunks (128 tokens) are enriched with contextual prepended headers [Document: Title | Section: Header] for high-precision embedding matching, while full Parent sections (1024 tokens) are passed to the LLM for generation.

Top-50 hybrid candidates are rescored with cross-attention token interaction, authority tier weights (official=1.0, web=0.4), and exponential temporal decay so outdated circulars do not mislead generation.
Detects divergent claims across documents on matching topics. Automatically marks older conflicting entries as temporal_superseded and renders transparent discrepancy cards in the transcript.

frameworks.heading: 3. Operating System Security Rings & Sandbox Isolation
frameworks.summary: Decouples the AI orchestrator brain from disposable sandboxes. Enforces human approval and zero-persistence secret sharing for privileged mutations.

chunks.section: The Agent is Not the Sandbox
chunks.content: The AI brain orchestrates via gRPC/IPC, while tool execution and untrusted web browsing run inside disposable gVisor/Wasm sandboxes with zero access to host databases, private subnets, or master secrets.

Ring 1 actions halt execution via await_checkpoint SSE events. Users resolve via ApprovalCard or SecretShareCard. Sensitive credentials remain in volatile memory and are never saved in Postgres chat history.

frameworks.heading: 4. Second Me Tri-Tier Cognitive Memory System
frameworks.summary: Maintains persistent cognitive continuity across sessions while dynamically calibrating persona parameters and guaranteeing zero secret leaks.

chunks.content: Working memory handles composer buffer and context chips. Episodic memory stores user decisions and feedback history. Semantic memory indexes domain graphs and documents.
Dynamically calibrates conciseness (0.0-1.0), technical depth, tone (neutral/executive/creative), and language (en-US/bn-BD), synthesizing a unified cognitive prompt header before generation.

frameworks.heading: 5. Agentic Engineering Loop & Pre-mortem Protocol
frameworks.formula: Pipeline = Claude Code + Conductor + GitNexus + Context7 + Postgres RLS + Premortem.md
frameworks.summary: Replaces stochastic one-shot guessing with an iterative Perceive -> Draft -> Verify (tsc/vitest) -> Reflect -> Commit closed loop.

chunks.content: Accept dependencies, don't create them. Components and hooks expose injectable interfaces (StreamTransport, ComposerAction) enabling deterministic unit tests without monkey-patching globals.
Simulates catastrophic failure modes (UX friction, runaway tool loops, database credential leaks, halluncinations, audio collisions) before committing code to production branches.
